summary: Build defensible transfer pricing skills with OECD-aligned methods, documentation, and audit-ready workflows. Book this 5-day course.
lede: Transfer pricing examines how related businesses price and document transactions between them. For tax, finance and reporting professionals, this course provides practice mapping controlled transactions, preparing functional and comparability analyses, and selecting a pricing method. Participants also work on adjustment schedules and documentation outlines to support related-party pricing positions during review.
audienceIntro: This transfer pricing fundamentals course is designed for professionals who already work with intercompany pricing, tax documentation, or cross-border reporting and need sharper technical control.
outcomes: Master File And Local File Preparation
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of corporate income tax concepts, basic financial statements, and intercompany transactions. Familiarity with accounting records, ERP extracts, or tax compliance workflows is helpful. No coding is required, and advanced transfer pricing concepts are taught at an operational application level rather than technical engineering depth.
